title: Linear Function Composed with a Quadratic
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: With $f(x)=x^{2}$ and $g(x)=2x+1$, determine the formula for $(g\circ f)(x)$ and compare it with $(f\circ g)(x)$.

steps.title: Identify Inner and Outer Functions
steps.explanation: In $g\circ f$ the squaring function $f$ runs first and the linear function $g$ acts on its output.
steps.why: Reversing the order of composition changes which function is applied first.

steps.title: Substitute the Square into the Linear Rule
steps.why: Every occurrence of the input variable in $g$ must be replaced by the whole inner expression.

steps.title: Simplify and Compare
steps.explanation: The result is $2x^2+1$, which differs from $(f\circ g)(x)=4x^2+4x+1$ found in Exercise 37.
steps.why: The mismatch shows that function composition is not commutative in general.
